title: Junior Recruitment Associate Job at Fadac Resources and Services Limited
content:
Fadac Resources and Services Limited is a consulting firm that provides businesses with human capital solutions that can help improve operational performance while reducing employment practice risk. They also help organizations no matter how large or small to establish, outsource and troubleshoot any human resources functions/challenges.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Posiiton: Junior Recruitment Associate
Job Location: Ogudu, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time 

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Recruitment Staff to support our recruitment team in sourcing, screening, and coordinating candidates for various job opportunities.


Key Responsibilities


	Source and screen suitable candidates for available job positions.
	Review CVs and shortlist qualified candidates.
	Conduct initial candidate interviews and assessments.
	Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and clients.
	Maintain and update candidate records and the recruitment database.
	Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
	Assist senior recruiters with recruitment activities and client requirements.
	Support other administrative duties related to recruitment.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field with 1-2 years of experience.
	Previous experience in recruitment or HR is an advantage.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
	Ability to work in a fast-paced and target-driven environment.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Accountant Job at Flour Mills of Nigeria Plc




        
    

        
        Flour Mills of Nigeria Plc has been a part of the lives of Nigerians at home and abroad. Our global vision is to be a leading foods company in Africa providing high quality and affordable products in the most convenient ways to consumers through world class brands like Golden Penny Flour, Golden Penny Semovita, Goldenvita, Golden Pasta and Golden Noodles. The Company's flagship brand, Golden Penny, remains one of the best known and the preferred brands amongst bakers, confectioneries and consumers in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Accountant 

Job Location: Benin, Edo

Purpose
     

            
    




	To oversee financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, inventory management, fixed asset accounting, cash flow management, and business support activities, while ensuring compliance with financial regulations and providing accurate financial information to support effective decision-making across Agri Palm Limited.


The Job  


	Prepare timely and accurate monthly management accounts and financial reports.
	Coordinate the preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts to support business planning and performance management.
	Conduct financial analysis and provide insights to support management decision-making.
	Perform regular account reconciliations, including general ledger and sub-ledger reconciliations, and promptly resolve identified variances.
	Maintain fixed asset registers and schedules, ensuring accurate capitalization, depreciation, and asset tracking.
	Monitor and manage cash flow activities to support operational and strategic objectives.
	Process payroll accurately and ensure timely payment of salaries and related obligations.
	Process vendor payments and maintain strong controls over accounts payable activities.
	Oversee accounts receivable and accounts payable functions to ensure efficiency and accuracy.


Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or a related discipline.
	Professional certification from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria (ICAN) is required.


Experience:


	Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Accounting, Financial Reporting, Audit, Financial Analysis, or a related finance role.
	Experience in budgeting, forecasting, inventory accounting, and fixed asset management is desirable.


The Person Must: 


	Possess strong financial reporting, budgeting, and financial analysis skills.
	Demonstrate sound knowledge of accounting principles, financial controls, and regulatory compliance requirements.
	Have a strong understanding of inventory management and fixed asset accounting.
	Have experience using ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics AX, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar platforms.

CEWA Medical Manager Job at Beiersdorf




        
    

        
        Beiersdorf  - For more than 130 years, care for consumers and our people is what has driven us. Every day, our global brand icons, such as NIVEA, Eucerin, and Hansaplast, make more than 500 million consumers in over 200 countries feel good in their skin.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: CEWA Medical Manager 

Job Location: Lagos

Your Tasks
     

            
    




	To lead and execute the CEWA Medical Strategy for Eucerin across CEWA markets, currently including Nigeria and Kenya, by translating global and regional scientific priorities into locally relevant plans that strengthen scientific credibility, advance healthcare professional education and engagement, generate actionable medical insights, and support responsible, sustainable business growth.
	The role leads the Medical Detailing team and ensures that all medical activities and communications meet scientific, ethical, regulatory and compliance standards.


Responsibilties


	CEWA Medical Strategy & Planning : Develop and execute CEWA Medical Strategy and annual country plans aligned with Global, Regional, brand and business priorities, adapting to local needs and market maturity.
	Medical Detailing & Field Excellence: Lead and coach the Medical Detailing team on HCP segmentation, targeting, coverage, frequency and call quality, ensuring scientific, ethical and compliant execution.
	Medical Education & Training: Develop and deliver scientific onboarding, certification and continuous training for Medical Detailers, Sales Representatives and Dermo-Consultants, ensuring knowledge application in the field.
	KOL, DOL, Society & Institutional Partnerships: Build strategic relationships with KOLs, DOLs, medical societies, universities and healthcare institutions through compliant advisory boards, round tables and scientific programmes.
	Congresses & Scientific Engagement: Lead the annual congress and scientific engagement plan, including professional events, speakers, booths and digital activities, and measure impact and learnings.
	Medical Insights & Scientific Intelligence: Gather and analyse HCP, KOL, field and competitive insights on scientific trends, unmet needs and treatment behaviours to inform strategy, training and innovation.
	Evidence Generation & Scientific Dissemination: Identify local evidence gaps and support clinical, real-world evidence and consumer studies, including abstracts, publications and scientific presentations.
	Scientific Content, Claims & Communications Governance: Review and approve scientific claims, medical materials, training, PR, digital and congress content to ensure accuracy, substantiation, balance and compliance.
	Product Launch, Lifecycle & Regulatory Support: Lead medical readiness for launches and relaunches, including scientific narratives, evidence translation, FAQs, objection handling and field-force training.
	Performance, Budget & Operations: Manage a balanced scorecard covering HCP reach, detailing quality, training, KOL engagement, insights, congress impact, CRM quality, budget and compliance.


Your Profile


	Education and Qualifications - Medical or Health Sciences Degree required. An additional qualification in dermatology, public health, medical affairs or business is advantageous.
	Experience - Typically, 3-4 years of relevant experience in Medical Affairs, medical detailing, the pharmaceutical industry or dermocosmetics, including people management responsibility. Demonstrated experience working with physicians, KOLs, field teams, congresses, scientific training and large audiences.
	Skills - Strong scientific communication and presentation skills; strategic planning; coaching and people leadership; stakeholder and relationship management; project and budget management; analytical thinking; digital engagement; and confident use of CRM and performance data. Fluent English is required.
